title: Style Guide: Voice Wardrobe Assistant with LangChain and NVIDIA NIM
summary: Karim Lalani demos Style Guide, a voice assistant that recommends outfits from your wardrobe photos.
learn: You upload clothing photos; a vision model describes them and the details are stored in a vector database.
NVIDIA inference microservices (NIM) are hosted inference that NVIDIA runs, or you can host it yourself.
The NVIDIA model in LangChain lacked tool calling, so he wrote a wrapper that adds it to a model.
The vision model was weak at JSON, so he fed its output into Llama 3 for structured output.
The agent graph is simple: an Oracle node, a tool node and a summarize node.
